note:
Wheels cut as DISCS found by circular fit -- 98% and 97% ring solidity. Colour detection fragmented every time because the tyres are shaded rather than flat, and it never found a whole rim. The body has both discs removed, so a rotating wheel drawn behind it shows through the hole rather than over the axle.

Rotate about `centre` in the assembly's own coordinates. Rotation rate follows DISTANCE TRAVELLED, not time: a wheel of radius r turns one revolution per 2*pi*r of ground covered, so the rear and front turn at different rates and both stop when the coach does.
